title: Audit TermAl's existing test portfolio after sync
outcome: Audit TermAl's existing test portfolio after sync
acceptance: TermAl's existing tests are reviewed in its own tracker by suite and concrete case, with keep, simplify or remove recommendations and reasons
Each recommendation addresses the protected observable behavior, implementation-detail brittleness, cost or timeout versus benchmark character, and duplication or cheaper available proof
Prioritized findings have named Sol/Opus implementation owners and introduce no new gate
Host-behavior tests that mention source_file_size or source_id are evaluated by what they prove rather than deleted by name, and the audit does not block current sync landings
